content_units: You already have a credible pivot story for   Learning Experience Designer   and   Corporate Trainer   roles. Your strongest angle is not “teacher trying something new,” but   experienced facilitator and learning designer moving from classroom learning to workplace learning  .
-   Primary path:   Corporate Trainer / Learning Specialist / Learning & Development Specialist
-   Stretch path in 90–180 days:   Learning Experience Designer / Instructional Designer
-   Salary realism in Dublin:     €50,000+ is achievable  , especially for corporate training, L&D specialist, and some instructional design roles with strong portfolio evidence
Days 1–15   Reposition your story   Rewrite CV headline; convert teaching outcomes to business-learning language; optimize LinkedIn; draft target-role pitch   New CV + LinkedIn + 30-second intro
Days 16–30   Build market-ready evidence   Create 2 portfolio samples; document workshop facilitation; write 3 short case studies   Basic portfolio site or PDF portfolio
Days 31–60   Close core skill gaps   Learn ADDIE; adult learning; Kirkpatrick; Articulate Storyline or Rise; LMS basics   1 e-learning sample + 1 evaluation plan
Days 61–75   Target active job search   Apply to Dublin hybrid/remote roles; tailor CV by title; network with L&D professionals; contact recruiters   20–30 tailored applications
Days 76–90   Improve interview conversion   Practice behavioral answers; prepare portfolio walkthrough; refine salary narrative; build follow-up cadence   Interview kit + offer-ready materials
Position your teaching experience as   business-relevant learning work  :
Option 1: Facilitation and delivery   You have 8 years of live instruction, stakeholder communication, and learner engagement   Strong fit for Corporate Trainer
Option 2: Learning design   Lesson planning, scaffolding, assessment design, and adapting for mixed abilities map well to instructional design   Strong fit for Learning Experience Designer

Option 3: Communication and stakeholder management   Parent communication, department collaboration, presenting to groups, and workshop delivery show cross-functional influence   Strong fit for L&D Specialist

Option 4: Measurement mindset   Student progress tracking, formative assessment, and intervention planning can be reframed as learning impact and performance support   Useful for more strategic L&D roles
- “Designed and delivered engaging learning experiences for diverse groups of 25–150 learners”
- “Created structured learning materials aligned to measurable outcomes”
- “Facilitated workshops and adapted delivery based on learner feedback and performance data”
- “Used digital tools to create presentations, job aids, and visual learning resources”
- “Managed multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder needs in fast-paced environments”
Resume Repositioning for Dublin L&D Hiring
Your CV should read like an   L&D candidate with strong facilitation experience  , not an education CV.
Learning & Development Professional   Facilitator   Aspiring Learning Experience Designer

“Learning professional with 8 years’ experience designing and facilitating engaging learning for secondary learners, with strong strengths in workshop delivery, content structuring, learner engagement, and digital content creation. Transitioning into corporate L&D with hands-on skills in PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Canva, and facilitation, and building capability in instructional design tools and adult learning practice.”
- Taught English to secondary students across multiple year groups
- Designed and facilitated structured learning sessions for diverse groups, tailoring content to different ability levels and learning needs
- Assessed student work and tracked progress
- Measured learner progress against defined outcomes and used feedback/data to refine content and delivery
- Developed slide decks, visual learning materials, and learner-facing resources using PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and Canva
Portfolio Projects That Will Make You Credible
You do not need a huge portfolio. You need   3 focused pieces   that match the jobs.
Option 1: Instructor-led workshop kit   A 60-minute corporate workshop on business writing, feedback skills, or presentation basics   Best for Corporate Trainer
Option 2: E-learning module   A 5–10 minute self-paced module in Rise or Storyline on onboarding, communication, or inclusive meetings   Best for Learning Experience Designer
- Short note on why you made those design choices
Option 3: Job aid + microlearning set   One-page quick guide plus short visual assets on email etiquette, giving feedback, or running meetings   Shows practical workplace learning design
Best portfolio topics for your background
- 1-page Notion site, Google Drive folder, or PDF portfolio
- Why you designed it that way
Skill Gaps to Close in the Next 90 Days
You already have facilitation and content structuring. The biggest gaps are   corporate L&D frameworks, authoring tools, and business-facing vocabulary  .
-   Adult learning principles  : andragogy, motivation, relevance, application
-   Instructional design frameworks  : ADDIE, backward design, basic needs analysis
-   Evaluation  : Kirkpatrick levels, simple learning metrics
-   Authoring tools  : Articulate Rise first, then Storyline basics
-   LMS familiarity  : Moodle, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, or SAP SuccessFactors at a basic awareness level
-   Business acumen  : how training supports performance, onboarding, compliance, sales, customer service, or leadership goals
- Weeks 1–2: ADDIE, adult learning, training needs analysis
- Weeks 5–6: Facilitation in corporate settings, virtual delivery techniques
- Weeks 9–12: Build portfolio, tailor CV, interview practice
- Canva: already useful for visuals/job aids
- Learn   Storyline basics   if targeting designer roles more heavily
Job Titles to Search in Dublin and Remote Ireland
Search broadly. Many suitable roles are not titled “Learning Experience Designer.”
“instructional designer” OR “learning experience designer” OR “corporate trainer” OR “learning and development specialist” OR “training specialist” Dublin OR Ireland remote
